test_asfreq_period_conversion: test the PeriodIndex.asfreq method converts periods between different frequencies like Y, Q, M, D, h, Min, s
test_asfreq_with_nat_values: test the PeriodIndex.asfreq method handles NaT values correctly when converting to a different frequency
test_asfreq_multiplied_period_index: test the PeriodIndex.asfreq method with multiplied frequencies like 2M converting to D or 3D
test_asfreq_combined_period_frequency: test the PeriodIndex.asfreq method with combined period frequencies like 1D1h or 1h1D
test_asfreq_invalid_frequency_raises: test that PeriodIndex.asfreq raises ValueError for unsupported or invalid frequencies like 2BMS or 2YE-MAR
